name: @theo-startups/bnpm
description: Better npm — install-time block gates, policy enforcement, and supply-chain hygiene

scripts.build: bun build src/cli.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='dist/cli.js';fs.writeFileSync(p,'#!/usr/bin/env bun\n'+fs.readFileSync(p))" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
